title: REQ · Contribution, player, world and round routes are unchanged
summary: Non-execution routes behave exactly as before the removal
description: Context: contribution intake and round lifecycle must stay intact. Desired behavior: server.New still mounts healthz, player session/me, world routes, round/current, contribution create/mine/get and admin round routes with the same handlers. Expected result: unchanged statuses and bodies. Why: owner-kept features must not regress.
acceptance_criteria: Given server.New, when POST /api/v1/contributions, GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions and GET /api/v1/contributions/{id} are sent, then they reach the contribution handlers
Given server.New, when GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current and admin round routes are sent, then the existing statuses are returned
technical_constraints: No change to route patterns or handler wiring
definition_of_done: Route registrations for kept routes are unmodified
